title: Embeddings of Affine Spaces into Quadrics
source_result_reviewed: Theorem 3, especially part (3), produces inequivalent affine-plane images in the smooth three-dimensional quadric SL2. Theorem 2 distinguishes image equivalence from extension of source parameterizations.
use: Context for keeping ambient symmetry saturation separate from any universal embedding rectification or factorization theorem.
not_transferred: No claim about all embeddings into the five-dimensional ambient affine space follows from this paper.
No generation theorem for the full polynomial symmetry group of the ambient quadratic is imported.
No arbitrary source parameterization is inferred to preserve the actual source Hessian.
